LightningComponentBundle.description: Lays out the Boundary Application Network graph (75% width) and the Boundary Impact Panel (25% width) side by side on one page, so an admin can see the visual map and the detailed list together.

property.name: objectApiName
property.label: Object API Name
property.description: The API name of the Salesforce object to check by default, e.g. Account or a custom object such as Invoice__c. Each side still has its own picker to switch objects.

property.name: fieldApiName
property.label: Field API Name (optional)
property.description: Narrow the default check to a single field on the object.

property.name: fieldApiName
property.label: Field API Name (optional)
property.description: Narrow the check to a single field on this record's object.
